_: A組 #5+#6 + F組 #3 full dynamic encounter. A ChangeLocation Story-Manager quest that fires only in a location with a LocType keyword (locationFilter, OR'd), not more often than cooldownHours (anti-spam, EE_WITimeout), and on fire dynamically spawns 3 bandits near the player on valid navmesh (spawn → MFDynamicSpawn). The build appends GetKeywordDataForCurrentLocation conditions, creates a <quest>_LastFired GLOB + MFEncounterCooldown script, and attaches MFDynamicSpawn with the form/count/distance props. ⚠ locationFilter conditions are pure CTDA (offline-verifiable); the cooldown + spawn SCRIPTS' runtime behaviour (GetCurrentGameTime / PlaceAtMe + EnableAI navmesh snap) need a main-machine in-game check (see WAIT_USER). FormIDs verified vs Skyrim.esm 2026-06-17 (LocTypeBanditCamp 0x0130DF, LocTypeDungeon 0x0130DB, LCharBanditMeleeAny 0x03DECD — a leveled list so PlaceAtMe rolls a random melee bandit per spawn).

storyEvent._: Fires only in a bandit camp OR a dungeon, at most once per 12 in-game hours.

aliases.name: NewLocation
aliases._: optional: the spawn doesn't use this alias, and a REQUIRED fromEvent alias can't fill when the quest is started any way OTHER than its event (e.g. console `startquest`) — a required unfillable alias auto-stops the quest before its startUpStage runs. optional lets the quest start (and the alias still fills from a real ChangeLocation event).

spawn._: On fire: 3 random melee bandits (LCharBanditMeleeAny) placed 400-900 units around the player (visible ambush range), spawned just above ground so they free-fall onto the surface. Earlier 1200-3500 put them out of sight / stuck in terrain.
